description: Invite someone to the organization by email with a role (owner, manager or viewer) and, optionally, the projects they will reach (projectAccess); they get an email to accept. Inviting an address that already belongs to a member creates nothing and says so. Requires a confirmationToken: call preview_operation with tool "invite_member" and these arguments first, show the returned plan to the user, and call this tool only after the user explicitly agrees. Needs the organization:manage permission and the owner role.

projectAccess.description: Optional. The projects the invitee will reach once they accept: {"mode": "all"}, the default, or {"mode": "selected", "projectIds": [...]} with 1 to 500 distinct project ids of this organization from list_projects; a repeated id counts once. An owner always reaches every project, so an owner invitation cannot carry a selection.

requestId.description: Optional idempotency key, 8-255 printable characters. Reuse it only to retry this same call.

name: invite_member
title: Invite a member
